title: Copilot local app data
whyItMatters: The Copilot app keeps local session state and browsing data alongside the account's chat history. It shows the app was used on this machine.
source: AI forensics handbook (urock-ailab.github.io/forensics-handbook/ai/02-artifacts/chat-services/copilot/windows.html): Store app data under %LOCALAPPDATA%/Packages/Microsoft.Copilot_*
notes: source uncertain: Microsoft documents Copilot chat history as account/cloud based and publishes no local history path, and the app data suffix varies by build. Windows 11 22H2+; newer app (2026-08-18) also uses LOCALAPPDATA/Microsoft/Copilot/User Data. Metadata only.
